# Quarry planner conformance cases (spec: crates/vesper-quarry/spec/planner-ddl.md).
#
# Each case: "== name", one "plan:" line (the access path the cost model of
# the spec must choose for each FROM binding, in FROM order), optional
# "params:" line (name:TYPE=value, comma separated; value is an integer,
# 'text' or null), then the SQL on one line. The data set and indexes are
# defined in tests/planner_spec.rs (`build_store`) and the spec.
#
# Plan notation: alias=scan | alias=index(INDEX,eq|range|lower|upper)
#                | alias=index_join(INDEX,OUTER_ALIAS.COLUMN)

== point_eq_literal
plan: p=index(p_age,eq)
SELECT id, name FROM p WHERE age = 30

== point_eq_unique
plan: p=index(p_id,eq)
SELECT id, age, city FROM p WHERE id = 17

== point_eq_param
plan: p=index(p_age,eq)
params: a:I64=30
SELECT id FROM p WHERE age = :a

== point_eq_null_param
plan: p=index(p_age,eq)
params: a:I64=null
SELECT id FROM p WHERE age = :a

== wide_range_scans
plan: p=scan
SELECT id FROM p WHERE age >= 10 AND age <= 60

== lower_open_range
plan: p=index(p_id,lower)
SELECT id, name FROM p WHERE id >= 395

== upper_open_range_exclusive
plan: p=index(p_id,upper)
SELECT id FROM p WHERE id < 5

== reversed_operands
plan: p=index(p_id,upper)
SELECT id FROM p WHERE 5 > id

== two_indexes_cheaper_wins
plan: p=index(p_age,eq)
SELECT id FROM p WHERE age = 30 AND id > 300

== unselective_text_eq_scans
plan: p=scan
SELECT id FROM p WHERE city = 'oslo'

== empty_text_range
plan: p=index(p_city,lower)
SELECT id FROM p WHERE city >= 'z'

== no_index_scans
plan: p=scan
SELECT id FROM p WHERE name = 'p5'

== or_is_not_sargable
plan: p=scan
SELECT id FROM p WHERE id = 3 OR id = 9

== not_equal_is_not_sargable
plan: p=scan
SELECT id FROM p WHERE id <> 3

== is_null_is_not_indexed
plan: p=scan
SELECT id FROM p WHERE city IS NULL

== second_table_range
plan: o=index(o_amount,lower)
SELECT id, owner FROM o WHERE amount >= 990

== index_nested_loop_join
plan: p=index(p_id,eq) o=index_join(o_owner,p.id)
SELECT p.name, o.id, o.amount FROM p JOIN o ON o.owner = p.id WHERE p.id = 17

== index_nested_loop_left_join
plan: p=index(p_id,lower) o=index_join(o_owner,p.id)
SELECT p.id, o.id AS oid FROM p LEFT JOIN o ON o.owner = p.id WHERE p.id >= 398

== unselective_outer_uses_scan
plan: p=scan o=scan
SELECT p.id, o.id AS oid FROM p JOIN o ON o.owner = p.id WHERE p.age >= 0

# WHERE on the nullable side of an outer join stays above the join, so it
# is not sargable; the preserved side o keeps its own index path.
== right_join_preserved_side_only
plan: p=scan o=index(o_amount,upper)
SELECT p.id, o.id AS oid FROM p RIGHT JOIN o ON o.owner = p.id WHERE o.amount < 20 AND p.age = 66

== probe_too_many_matches_scans
plan: c=scan p=scan
SELECT c.label, p.id FROM c JOIN p ON p.city = c.code WHERE c.code = 'oslo'

== self_join_two_paths
plan: a=index(p_id,eq) b=index(p_age,eq)
SELECT a.id, b.id AS other FROM p a JOIN p b ON b.age = a.age WHERE a.id = 3 AND b.age = 21
